question: Let $f$ be a function from a set $X$ to $X$ such that $f(f(x))=x$ for all $x\in X$. Then

options.A: $f$ is one-to-one but need not be onto
options.B: $f$ is onto but need not be one-to-one
options.D: none of the foregoing statements is necessarily true

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10+2 Level
